title: Simultaneous and long-term measurement of gene expression and neuronal activity from a brain slice
protocol: Place the MED probe in a sterilized disposable Petri dish (100 mm diameter).
Rinse the MED probe three times with sterile distilled water (SDW).
Rinse the MED probe once with 70% EtOH about 15-30 minutes.
Rinse the MED probe again three times with SDW.
Dry up and expose the MED probe to UV light for 15-30 minutes.
Treat the surface of the MED probe with brief (within one second) exposures to a blue flame, repeated 8-12 times.
Cool each exposure for approximately 10 seconds after treatment.
Place the MED probe in a cold pack at 4 ºC for about 15 minutes.
Mix 0.8 ml collagen Type I-C, 0.1 ml x10 DMEM, and 0.1 ml buffer on ice.
Apply the mixed collagen solution to the MED probe until the surface is evenly wet.
Remove any excess collagen solution from the probe.
Place SDW in the Petri dish outside of the MED probe to maintain moisture.
Incubate the MED probe at 37 ºC for 1-2 hours to firm the collagen gel.
Rinse the MED probe with sterile distilled water (SDW) one time.
Pre-incubate the MED probe with culturing medium containing 5% FBS until use.
Obtain hypothalamic slices \(200µm thick) containing the SCN from the hypothalamic block \(≈ 2 x 1 x 5 mm) of mice of 2-5 days of age using a tissue chopper.
Trim and place hypothalamic slice containing the SCN on the collagen-coated MED probe using a transfer pipette.
Set the slice so that the SCN covers the electrodes.
Remove medium from the MED probe.
Incubate the SCN slice in a CO<sub>2</sub> incubator with 100% humidity for 1-2 h until the slice attaches to the collagen gel.
Add 250μl culturing medium containing 5% FBS into the MED probe after 1-2 h incubation.
Incubate the SCN in a CO<sub>2</sub> incubator and exchange half volume of medium every day for the first 10 culture days, thereafter every other day.
For the first three days, medium should contain 5% FBS, but thereafter 5% of supplement instead of serum.
Place the MED probe with cultured SCN slice in an MED connector.
Set up recording by placing the connector in the stage-top incubator of a microscope.
Seal the MED probe with O₂ permeable film using silicone grease along the edge of the probe wall.
Maintain humidity and oxygen level stability for the cultured SCN slice inside the sealed probe.
Cover the microscope with a dark box to prevent extraneous light interference during imaging.
Set up the CCD camera at the top port for the upright microscope.
Create a hole in the stage-top incubator for the objective lens of the upright microscope.
Seal the hole in the stage-top incubator with insulation foam.
Warm the objective lens of the upright microscope with a heating band.
Set up the CCD camera at the bottom port for the inverted microscope.
Warm the objective lens beneath the MED probe on the inverted microscope.
Adjust threshold levels to count spontaneous firing frequency in SCN slices, setting signal-to-noise ratio ≈ 2.0.
